displayPattern: Status LED: 2 short flash(es) then 1 long flash(es) (code 21)
meaning: Gas heating lockout. Control will NOT auto-reset.
causes: Stuck closed gas valve relay on control (defective control)
diySteps: Turn off power and wait 5 minutes to retry
Technician: check gas valve wiring and the control valve relay
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: always; this lockout does not clear on its own and points to a gas valve circuit fault.
